form.label: OCP Enterprise Incident Command Center v8.0
form.description: Multi-application OCP operations dashboard for L1, L2, SRE and leadership. Provides impact-first triage, API and Kafka investigation, transaction correlation, reliability metrics and onboarding guidance.

html.div: $selected_app_label$ | Project: $selected_project$ | Data Center: $datacenter$ Impact → Evidence → Action → Recovery

search.query: index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_overview$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter')) | eval ns=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns,"man"),"MAN",match(ns,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns,"str"),"STR",match(ns,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval is_error=if(match(_raw,"(?i)ERROR|FATAL|Exception|CrashLoopBackOff|OOMKilled|ImagePullBackOff|SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE"),1,0) | stats count as total sum(is_error) as errors | eval Score=round(max(0,100-(errors*100/max(total,1))),1) | fields Score

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_overview$ | where gate=1 | search (ERROR OR FATAL OR Exception OR CrashLoopBackOff OR OOMKilled OR ImagePullBackOff OR SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE) | stats count

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_overview$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), code=coalesce(statusCode,status_code,http_status,httpStatus,responseCode) | rex field=txt "(?<code2>4[0-9]{2}|5[0-9]{2})" | eval code=coalesce(code,code2) | where tonumber(code)>=400 | stats count

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_overview$ | where gate=1 | search (kafka OR consumer OR producer OR chunk OR batch) (ERROR OR failed OR timeout OR stuck OR rebalance OR DLQ) | stats count

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_overview$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host) | stats dc(pod)

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_overview$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host,"Unknown"), container=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name',container_name,"Unknown"), dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,"UNKNOWN")) | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval Category=case(match(txt,"(?i)CrashLoopBackOff|OOMKilled|ImagePullBackOff|readiness probe|liveness probe"),"OCP / Pod",match(txt,"(?i)401|403|unauthorized|forbidden"),"Authentication",match(txt,"(?i)kafka|consumer|producer|rebalance|lag|DLQ"),"Kafka",match(txt,"(?i)database|oracle|sql|jdbc|deadlock"),"Database",match(txt,"(?i)NAS|permission denied|file not found|storage"),"NAS / Storage",match(txt,"(?i)ERROR|FATAL|Exception|timeout|failed"),"Application",true(),"Other") | where Category!="Other" | eval Severity=case(match(txt,"(?i)FATAL|CrashLoopBackOff|OOMKilled|SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE|DLQ"),"Critical",true(),"High") | eval Likely_Owner=case(Category="Kafka","Messaging / Application",Category="Database","Database / Application",Category="NAS / Storage","Storage / Application",Category="Authentication","IAM / Application",Category="OCP / Pod","OCP Platform / Application",true(),"Application") | eval Recommended_Action=case(Category="Kafka","Check consumer pod, lag growth, rebalance and latest committed offset",Category="Database","Confirm multi-pod impact and validate DB connectivity before escalation",Category="NAS / Storage","Validate destination path, permissions and latest successful write",Category="Authentication","Validate service account/token and capture correlation ID",Category="OCP / Pod","Capture pod state, restart count and previous-container logs",true(),"Capture correlation ID and normalized error evidence") | stats count as Events earliest(_time) as First_Seen latest(_time) as Last_Seen values(pod) as Pods values(container) as Containers latest(txt) as Evidence by Severity Category dc Likely_Owner Recommended_Action | convert ctime(First_Seen) ctime(Last_Seen) | sort -Events | head 25

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_overview$ | where gate=1 | search (ERROR OR FATAL OR Exception OR failed OR timeout OR CrashLoopBackOff OR OOMKilled OR kafka OR lag) | spath | eval pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host), dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,"UNKNOWN")), endpoint=coalesce(uri,path,endpoint,url,"Unknown"), topic=coalesce(topic,topicName,kafka_topic,"Unknown") | stats dc(pod) as Affected_Pods dc(dc) as Affected_DCs dc(endpoint) as Affected_Endpoints dc(topic) as Affected_Topics earliest(_time) as Started latest(_time) as Latest | eval Blast_Radius=case(Affected_DCs>1,"Enterprise / Multi-DC",Affected_Pods>3,"Regional / Widespread",Affected_Pods>1,"Localized",true(),"Isolated") | convert ctime(Started) ctime(Latest)

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_overview$ | where gate=1 | search (ERROR OR FATAL OR Exception OR timeout OR failed OR kafka OR lag OR CrashLoopBackOff OR OOMKilled) | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host,"Unknown") | eval Event=case(match(txt,"(?i)API.*fail|HTTP.*4[0-9]{2}|HTTP.*5[0-9]{2}"),"API failure detected",match(txt,"(?i)lag|rebalance|consumer.*timeout"),"Kafka degradation detected",match(txt,"(?i)database|jdbc|oracle|sql.*timeout"),"Database issue detected",match(txt,"(?i)CrashLoopBackOff|OOMKilled|ImagePullBackOff"),"Pod runtime issue detected",true(),"Application error detected") | bin _time span=1m | stats count as Events values(pod) as Pods latest(txt) as Evidence by _time Event | sort 0 _time | tail 30

html.p: Use this view to identify the failing layer, likely owner and immediate L1 action. Runtime conclusions must be confirmed in OCP before restarting or scaling.

search.query: index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_investigation$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host,"Unknown"), container=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name',container_name,"Unknown"), txt=coalesce(message,_raw), pf=lower("$pod_filter$") | where pf="*" OR like(lower(pod),"%".pf."%") OR like(lower(container),"%".pf."%") | stats count as Events sum(eval(if(match(txt,"(?i)ERROR|FATAL|Exception|CrashLoopBackOff|OOMKilled|ImagePullBackOff"),1,0))) as Error_Events latest(_time) as Last_Log latest(txt) as Latest_Evidence by pod container | eval Log_Age_Min=round((now()-Last_Log)/60,1), State=case(match(Latest_Evidence,"(?i)CrashLoopBackOff|OOMKilled|ImagePullBackOff"),"RED — Runtime issue",Error_Events>0,"AMBER — Application errors",Log_Age_Min>15,"GREY — Stale logs",true(),"GREEN — Reporting") | convert ctime(Last_Log) | sort State -Error_Events

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_investigation$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host), endpoint=coalesce(uri,path,endpoint,url,'message.uri','message.path'), method=upper(coalesce(method,http_method,'message.method')) , code=coalesce(statusCode,status_code,http_status,httpStatus,responseCode), latency=coalesce(duration,response_time,latency,elapsed_ms), correlation=coalesce(correlationId,correlation_id,traceId,trace_id,requestId,request_id) | rex field=txt "(?<code2>4[0-9]{2}|5[0-9]{2})" | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:correlation|trace|request)[_-]?id[=: ]+[2']?(?<corr2>[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+)" | eval code=coalesce(code,code2), correlation=coalesce(correlation,corr2), endpoint=coalesce(endpoint,"Unknown") | where tonumber(code)>=400 | eval Failure=case(code=401,"Unauthorized",code=403,"Forbidden",code=404,"Not Found",tonumber(code)>=500,"Server / Dependency Failure",true(),"Client Error"), Recommended_Action=case(code=401 OR code=403,"Validate service account/token and auth dependency",code=404,"Validate route and requested resource",tonumber(code)>=500,"Check pod errors and downstream dependency evidence",true(),"Validate request and correlation ID") | stats count as Failures avg(latency) as Avg_Latency_MS max(latency) as Max_Latency_MS values(pod) as Pods latest(correlation) as Correlation_ID latest(txt) as Evidence by method endpoint code Failure Recommended_Action | sort -Failures

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") (kafka OR consumer OR producer OR chunk OR batch OR offset OR lag) | eval gate=$gate_investigation$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host), topic=coalesce(topic,topicName,kafka_topic,"Unknown"), group=coalesce(consumerGroup,consumer_group,groupId,group_id,"Unknown"), chunk=coalesce(chunkId,chunk_id,batchId,batch_id,messageId,message_id), lag=coalesce(consumerLag,consumer_lag,lag) | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:consumer[ _-]?lag|lag)[=: ]+(?<lag2>[0-9]+)" | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:chunk|batch|message)[_-]?(?:id)?[=: ]+[2']?(?<chunk2>[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+)" | eval lag=tonumber(coalesce(lag,lag2)), chunk=coalesce(chunk,chunk2) | eval produced=if(match(txt,"(?i)produced|published|sent to kafka"),1,0), consumed=if(match(txt,"(?i)consumed|consumer.*received|message received"),1,0), completed=if(match(txt,"(?i)complete|success|committed|written to database|written to NAS"),1,0), failed=if(match(txt,"(?i)fail|error|exception|timeout|DLQ|dead-letter"),1,0), retried=if(match(txt,"(?i)retry|reprocess"),1,0) | stats max(lag) as Lag sum(produced) as Produced sum(consumed) as Consumed sum(completed) as Completed sum(failed) as Failed sum(retried) as Retried earliest(_time) as First_Seen latest(_time) as Last_Seen values(pod) as Pods latest(txt) as Evidence by topic group chunk | eval Age_Sec=now()-Last_Seen, Condition=case(Lag>=tonumber("$lag_critical$"),"RED — Critical lag",Produced>0 AND Consumed=0 AND Age_Sec>tonumber("$stuck_threshold_seconds$"),"RED — Orphan message",Consumed>0 AND Completed=0 AND Age_Sec>tonumber("$stuck_threshold_seconds$"),"RED — Stuck processing",Completed>1 OR Consumed>1,"AMBER — Possible duplicate",Retried>=3,"AMBER — Repeated retries",Failed>0,"RED — Failed",Lag>=tonumber("$lag_warning$"),"AMBER — Lag warning",true(),"GREEN — Normal") | convert ctime(First_Seen) ctime(Last_Seen) | sort Condition -Lag

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_investigation$ | where gate=1 | search (ERROR OR FATAL OR Exception OR failed OR timeout OR CrashLoopBackOff OR OOMKilled OR kafka OR lag OR DLQ) | spath | eval Application="$selected_app_label$", Project="$selected_project$", DC=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,"UNKNOWN")), Pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host,"Unknown"), Container=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name',container_name,"Unknown"), Evidence=coalesce(message,_raw), Correlation=coalesce(correlationId,correlation_id,traceId,trace_id,requestId,request_id), Chunk=coalesce(chunkId,chunk_id,batchId,batch_id), Topic=coalesce(topic,topicName,kafka_topic), Endpoint=coalesce(uri,path,endpoint,url) | eval Error_Signature=replace(Evidence,"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F-]{27,}","<ID>") | eval Error_Signature=replace(Error_Signature,"\d+","<N>") | stats count as Occurrences earliest(_time) as Started latest(_time) as Last_Seen values(Pod) as Pods values(Container) as Containers values(Endpoint) as Endpoints values(Topic) as Topics values(Correlation) as Correlation_IDs values(Chunk) as Chunk_IDs latest(Evidence) as Evidence by Application Project DC Error_Signature | convert ctime(Started) ctime(Last_Seen) | sort -Occurrences | head 100

html.p: Search by correlation, trace, request, chunk or batch ID. The journey follows API receipt → Kafka production → consumption → processing → database/NAS write → completion.

search.query: index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_journey$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host,"Unknown"), correlation=coalesce(correlationId,correlation_id,traceId,trace_id,requestId,request_id), chunk=coalesce(chunkId,chunk_id,batchId,batch_id) | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:correlation|trace|request)[_-]?id[=: ]+[2']?(?<corr2>[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+)" | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:chunk|batch)[_-]?(?:id)?[=: ]+[2']?(?<chunk2>[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+)" | eval correlation=coalesce(correlation,corr2), chunk=coalesce(chunk,chunk2), transaction_id=coalesce(correlation,chunk) | where isnotnull(transaction_id) AND ("$selected_correlation$"="*" OR correlation="$selected_correlation$") AND ("$selected_chunk$"="*" OR chunk="$selected_chunk$") | eval Stage=case(match(txt,"(?i)HTTP request received|API request received|incoming request|REST.*received"),"1 — API RECEIVED",match(txt,"(?i)produced|published|sent to kafka|producer.*success"),"2 — KAFKA PRODUCED",match(txt,"(?i)consumed|consumer.*received|message received"),"3 — KAFKA CONSUMED",match(txt,"(?i)processing started|start processing|chunk started|batch started"),"4 — PROCESSING STARTED",match(txt,"(?i)written to database|database write.*success|DB write.*success|written to NAS|file.*created|persisted"),"5 — DESTINATION WRITTEN",match(txt,"(?i)complete|completed|success|committed"),"6 — COMPLETED",match(txt,"(?i)fail|error|exception|timeout|DLQ|dead-letter"),"X — FAILED",true(),"OTHER") | where Stage!="OTHER" | stats earliest(_time) as Stage_Start latest(_time) as Stage_End values(pod) as Pods latest(txt) as Evidence by transaction_id correlation chunk Stage | eval Duration_Sec=Stage_End-Stage_Start, Status=if(Stage="X — FAILED","RED — FAILED","OBSERVED") | convert ctime(Stage_Start) ctime(Stage_End) | sort transaction_id Stage

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_journey$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host,"Unknown"), container=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name',container_name,"Unknown"), correlation=coalesce(correlationId,correlation_id,traceId,trace_id,requestId,request_id), chunk=coalesce(chunkId,chunk_id,batchId,batch_id) | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:correlation|trace|request)[_-]?id[=: ]+[2']?(?<corr2>[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+)" | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:chunk|batch)[_-]?(?:id)?[=: ]+[2']?(?<chunk2>[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+)" | eval correlation=coalesce(correlation,corr2), chunk=coalesce(chunk,chunk2) | where ("$selected_correlation$"!="*" AND correlation="$selected_correlation$") OR ("$selected_chunk$"!="*" AND chunk="$selected_chunk$") | eval Event=case(match(txt,"(?i)fail|error|exception|timeout|DLQ|dead-letter"),"FAILURE",match(txt,"(?i)retry|reprocess|rebalance"),"RETRY / REBALANCE",match(txt,"(?i)complete|success|committed|written"),"COMPLETED",match(txt,"(?i)consum|produc|receiv|process|start"),"PROCESSING",true(),"LOG") | table _time Event pod container correlation chunk txt | sort 0 _time | head 5000

html.p: Log-derived reliability indicators for operational trending. Formal SLO reporting should use agreed service definitions and summary-indexed data.

search.query: index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_sre$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), code=coalesce(statusCode,status_code,http_status,httpStatus,responseCode) | rex field=txt "(?<code2>[1-5][0-9]{2})" | eval code=tonumber(coalesce(code,code2)) | where isnotnull(code) | stats count as total count(eval(code<400)) as success | eval Success_Rate=round(success*100/max(total,1),2) | fields Success_Rate

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") (chunk OR batch OR processing) | eval gate=$gate_sre$ | where gate=1 | eval started=if(match(_raw,"(?i)processing started|chunk started|batch started"),1,0), completed=if(match(_raw,"(?i)completed|success|committed|written to database|written to NAS"),1,0) | stats sum(started) as Started sum(completed) as Completed | eval Completion_Rate=round(Completed*100/max(Started,1),2) | fields Completion_Rate

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_sre$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval latency=tonumber(coalesce(duration,response_time,latency,elapsed_ms,'message.duration')) | where isnotnull(latency) | stats perc95(latency) as P95_Latency_MS

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_sre$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), is_bad=if(match(txt,"(?i)ERROR|FATAL|Exception|failed|timeout|HTTP.*[45][0-9]{2}"),1,0) | stats count as total sum(is_bad) as bad | eval Actual_Success=100-(bad*100/max(total,1)), SLO=99.5, Allowed_Failure=100-SLO, Actual_Failure=100-Actual_Success, Budget_Consumed=round(Actual_Failure*100/Allowed_Failure,1) | fields Budget_Consumed

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_sre$ | where gate=1 | eval Category=case(match(_raw,"(?i)kafka|consumer|producer|lag|rebalance|DLQ"),"Kafka",match(_raw,"(?i)HTTP.*[45][0-9]{2}|statusCode"),"API",match(_raw,"(?i)CrashLoopBackOff|OOMKilled|ImagePullBackOff"),"Pod",match(_raw,"(?i)database|jdbc|oracle|sql.*timeout"),"Database",match(_raw,"(?i)ERROR|FATAL|Exception|failed|timeout"),"Application",true(),"Other") | where Category!="Other" | timechart span=5m count by Category limit=8

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$gate_sre$ | where gate=1 | search (ERROR OR FATAL OR Exception OR failed OR timeout) | eval Evidence=coalesce(message,_raw), Signature=replace(Evidence,"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F-]{27,}","<ID>") | eval Signature=replace(Signature,"\d+","<N>") | stats count as Recurrences earliest(_time) as First_Seen latest(_time) as Last_Seen dc(coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host)) as Affected_Pods values(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name)) as Data_Centers latest(Evidence) as Example by Signature | where Recurrences>=3 | eval Candidate=case(Recurrences>=50,"High-value automation / problem record",Recurrences>=10,"Recurring problem candidate",true(),"Monitor") | convert ctime(First_Seen) ctime(Last_Seen) | sort -Recurrences | head 50

div.p: Add one application profile to the Application dropdown using the format below:

tr.td: kubernetes.namespace_name, kubernetes.pod_name, kubernetes.container_name, datacenter or cluster_name
method, endpoint/path, status code, latency, correlation/trace/request ID
topic, consumer group, partition, offset, lag, message/chunk/batch ID
database/NAS target, write start, write completion, failure reason

ol.li: Confirm the Splunk index and OCP project return data.
Test one known API failure and confirm endpoint/status extraction.
Test one known Kafka message and confirm topic, lag and chunk ID extraction.
Validate the transaction journey using a known correlation or chunk ID.
Agree warning and critical thresholds with the application owner.
Attach an approved L1 runbook before production access is granted.

div.p: Production recommendation: move application mappings, thresholds, support owners, SLO targets and runbook links into a Splunk lookup so new applications can be onboarded without editing every search.

html.div: Operational safety: This dashboard uses log evidence. It does not replace live OCP, Kafka broker, database or storage health checks. L1 must follow approved runbooks and confirm runtime state before restart, scale or replay actions.
